name: Santa Fe (Spain)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, white and green with a white stripe twice as wide as the others, charged at the centre with the crowned arms of Santa Fe (a castle and a pomegranate, inscribed SANTA FE).
history: Santa Fe has been using its own arms and flag, although they have not been made official under the regional regulations, which does not prevent their widespread use.
